title: 2003 AMC 8 Problem 6
statement: Given the areas of the three squares in the figure, what is the area of the interior triangle?

solutions.text:
The side lengths of the squares are \[ \sqrt{169} = 13,\]\[ \sqrt{144} = 12, \] and \[ \sqrt{25} = 5. \] These lengths form a Pythagorean triple.

Therefore, the interior triangle is right. Its area is \[ \dfrac{1}{2} \cdot 5 \cdot 12 = 30. \]

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: The square areas give the side lengths of the three squares.
The side lengths form a \(5-12-13\) right triangle.
